outcome.description: After a four-day trial the jury found a valid contract, breach by Meera, and no proven affirmative defenses, and awarded Aesthetic Elements $93,329 in liquidated damages under the service agreement's 20%-of-replacement-cost clause (an unjust-enrichment award was precluded by the contract recovery). JNOV was denied, and the Iowa Court of Appeals affirmed.

source.caseName: Aesthetic Elements, Inc. v. Meera Enterprise, LLC
source.court: Iowa Court of Appeals, on appeal from the Iowa District Court for Linn County
